description: check.native precision exemplar: a local no closure captures is not revoked by an opaque call. Over-invalidation costs a native code generator exactly what under-invalidation costs it, so the fact that the constant survives the call must be published as positively as a revocation would be.

facts.subject: elapsed

facts.name: the constant survives the call, so its use afterwards folds
facts.subject: budget

facts.name: nothing is published on the diagnostic lane
